appearance_facts.fact: Five blue circular markers are plotted, each labeled above with a week number; markers rise from lower-left to upper-right.
Week 7 is lowest and leftmost; Week 11 is highest and rightmost; Weeks 8, 9, 10 lie between them in increasing order.
The Week 10 marker sits just below the 150 gridline level and to the right of Week 9, forming a steady ascending diagonal with the other points.

printed_facts.fact: Title: 'Additional Promotion Weeks: Ad Spend vs Sales'.
X-axis label 'Advertising Spend ($ thousands)' with ticks 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65, 70, 75.

public_definitions: User goal: 'Review the promotion-week dashboard, then choose the budget planning decision.'
Primary field: 'Campaign Approval Decision' with options 'Hold and request full-data analysis', 'Approve broader ad spend increase', 'Decline budget increase for upcoming promotions'.
Companion selects: Recommendation area ('Promotion ad spend'), Review record ('Additional promotion-week request'), Decision queue ('Promotion budget review').
uncertain: Exact numeric coordinates of each marker are read visually from gridlines, not printed as data labels.
No causal or ROI threshold is stated on the page; the decision rule linking the trend to a specific option is not printed.
